subject: Founders Lab consumption cap and top‑up exception request
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@comake.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: CoMake Labs Finance <finance@comake.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: reallocate founders stipend + consumption cap top-up

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Quick ask from the Founders Lab team: our cohort used more GPU hours than expected this quarter because two teams hit heavy model training and burst inference during demo week. We have a remaining promotional stipend of 50k tokens but actual consumption is ~72k equivalent.

Two requests — can we:
- reallocate unused portions of other cohorts' stipends to cover the overage for these two teams (temporary redistribution), or
- approve a one-time top-up (promotional) to cover the 22k token shortfall while we finalize usage patterns?

I attached a short usage extract (CoMake_usage_Q3.csv). Our finance team asked for a written note confirming any top-up is a one-off and not precedent-setting. Happy to sign an addendum.

Appreciate any flexibility — this program is early-stage and these teams are our flagships for the winter demo circuit. Let me know next steps and any information you need.

Best,
Emily Park
Program Manager, Founders Lab
CoMake Labs

Attachment: CoMake_usage_Q3.csv (CSV, 14KB)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily@comake.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: reallocate founders stipend + consumption cap top-up

Hi Emily — thanks for the context and the upload. I pulled the usage and glanced through the CSV — makes sense. We can be pragmatic here but will need an internal approval path and a short addendum for audit.

Proposed immediate path:
- Approve a one-time top-up equal to the shortfall (22k token-equivalent) as a promotional credit.
- Add a short MOU addendum confirming it is one-off and limited to this cohort; CoMake signs; Redwood signs.
- Track as a program exception in our accelerator ledger so Finance can reconcile.

I copied Ben and Lauren to scope the commercial treatment (one-time promo vs. credit redistribution) and confirm sign-off matrix. If we can get verbal OK today I can route the addendum for signature tomorrow.

—Steph
Steph Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Programs
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: reallocate founders stipend + consumption cap top-up

Quick notes from commercial:
- Preferred: one-time promotional top-up. Simpler for tracking and avoids touching other cohorts' allocations.
- Alternative (if CoMake insists): controlled redistribution where we move up to 25% of unused cohort stipends into this cohort, with program owner sign-off. More operational overhead.

For the top-up I recommend: 25k token-equivalent credit, valid for 90 days, non-refundable, tied to DL-2026-1789. Point-form for legal:
- One-time promo credit = 25,000 token-equivalent
- Valid 90 days from signature
- No ongoing entitlement; Redwood reserves right to decline future requests

If Finance needs a formal approval matrix, I can start the approval spreadsheet (will add Vivek for Finance OK).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Startups & Programs
Redwood Inference

Finance checklist from my side before we sign:
- Approval matrix (who signs on Redwood side) — proposed: Steph (AM), Ben (Sales Lead), Vivek (Finance).
- Addendum language: explicit "one-time" clause + reference to program ID.
- Record in accelerator exemptions log (I will add row).
- Confirm tax/GAAP implications — Vivek, can you confirm no revenue recognition issues for a small promo credit?

If Vivek gives the green light I can draft the MOU_topup_addendum.pdf and route to Emily for signature. I'll include the clause: "This promotional credit is granted solely for the named cohort and does not establish an ongoing credit policy."

—Lauren

- Validity: 90 days from signature.
- Terms: One-off exception tied to DL-2026-1789, non-precedent-setting.
- Action: I attached a short addendum (MOU_topup_addendum.pdf). Please sign and return via DocuSign at the link below. Once signed we will apply the credit to your account and send a confirmation.
